001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007/**
008 * Written as each bolus completes, just before {@link BolusIobEntryHistoryLog} (opcode 195), on
009 * t:slim X2 and Mobi. Tandem publishes no name for opcode 194, so this class name is provisional,
010 * and every payload field is exposed raw: the relations below are exact, but what the pump uses
011 * them for is not known. Bytes 12-13 were zero in every record observed.
012 * See https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpX2/issues/144.
013 */
014@HistoryLogProps(
015    opCode = 194,
016    displayName = "Bolus Delivery Summary"
017)
018public class BolusDeliverySummaryHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
019
020    private int unknownU8At10;
021    private int unknownU8At11;
022    private float unknownFloatAt14;
023    private float unknownFloatAt18;
024    private float unknownFloatAt22;
025
026    public BolusDeliverySummaryHistoryLog() {}
027
028    public BolusDeliverySummaryHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int unknownU8At10, int unknownU8At11, float unknownFloatAt14, float unknownFloatAt18, float unknownFloatAt22) {
029        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, unknownU8At10, unknownU8At11, unknownFloatAt14, unknownFloatAt18, unknownFloatAt22, 0);
030    }
031
032    public BolusDeliverySummaryHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int unknownU8At10, int unknownU8At11, float unknownFloatAt14, float unknownFloatAt18, float unknownFloatAt22, int headerHighNibble) {
033        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
034        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, unknownU8At10, unknownU8At11, unknownFloatAt14, unknownFloatAt18, unknownFloatAt22, headerHighNibble);
035        this.unknownU8At10 = unknownU8At10;
036        this.unknownU8At11 = unknownU8At11;
037        this.unknownFloatAt14 = unknownFloatAt14;
038        this.unknownFloatAt18 = unknownFloatAt18;
039        this.unknownFloatAt22 = unknownFloatAt22;
040    }
041
042    public int typeId() {
043        return 194;
044    }
045
046    /**
047     * <table border="1">
048     * <caption>Parsed fields for BolusDeliverySummaryHistoryLog:</caption>
049     * <tr><td><code>unknownU8At10</code></td><td><code>raw[10] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
050     * <tr><td><code>unknownU8At11</code></td><td><code>raw[11] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
051     * <tr><td><code>unknownFloatAt14</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readFloat(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
052     * <tr><td><code>unknownFloatAt18</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readFloat(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
053     * <tr><td><code>unknownFloatAt22</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readFloat(raw, 22)</code></td></tr>
054     * </table>
055     */
056    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
057        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
058        this.cargo = raw;
059        parseBase(raw);
060        this.unknownU8At10 = raw[10] & 0xFF;
061        this.unknownU8At11 = raw[11] & 0xFF;
062        this.unknownFloatAt14 = Bytes.readFloat(raw, 14);
063        this.unknownFloatAt18 = Bytes.readFloat(raw, 18);
064        this.unknownFloatAt22 = Bytes.readFloat(raw, 22);
065    }
066
067    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int unknownU8At10, int unknownU8At11, float unknownFloatAt14, float unknownFloatAt18, float unknownFloatAt22, int headerHighNibble) {
068        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
069            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(194, headerHighNibble),
070            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
071            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
072            new byte[]{ (byte) unknownU8At10, (byte) unknownU8At11, 0, 0 },
073            Bytes.toFloat(unknownFloatAt14),
074            Bytes.toFloat(unknownFloatAt18),
075            Bytes.toFloat(unknownFloatAt22)));
076    }
077
078    /**
079     * @return byte 10: the number of boluses, this one included, whose 194 records fall within
080     * roughly the last 60 minutes (the records they were summed from for
081     * {@link #getUnknownFloatAt22()}). The exact window edge could not be reproduced; records
082     * 60-61 minutes apart are sometimes in, sometimes out.
083     */
084    public int getUnknownU8At10() {
085        return unknownU8At10;
086    }
087
088    /**
089     * @return byte 11: increments by one per bolus and wraps from 29 to 0
090     */
091    public int getUnknownU8At11() {
092        return unknownU8At11;
093    }
094
095    /**
096     * @return ten times {@link BolusCompletedHistoryLog#getInsulinDelivered()} for this bolus
097     * (1.5 for a 0.15 U bolus), including partial and zero deliveries
098     */
099    public float getUnknownFloatAt14() {
100        return unknownFloatAt14;
101    }
102
103    /**
104     * @return equal to {@link #getUnknownFloatAt14()} in every record observed
105     */
106    public float getUnknownFloatAt18() {
107        return unknownFloatAt18;
108    }
109
110    /**
111     * @return the sum of {@link #getUnknownFloatAt14()} over the boluses counted in
112     * {@link #getUnknownU8At10()}
113     */
114    public float getUnknownFloatAt22() {
115        return unknownFloatAt22;
116    }
117}
